resources.string: Share and export

The snapshot reads all committed session history from the computer, not just the messages on screen. It does not include uncommitted content or attachment files, but may retain references to attachments.
Reconnect to the computer to read a new snapshot.
Save raw records as JSONL
Save a readable snapshot as Markdown
Create a read-only share link
To create a share link, sign in to the relay and register this device. You can still export files in LAN mode.
Create a link others can forward?

The snapshot may contain sensitive content, including prompts, model outputs, and tool records. It is encrypted on your phone first. Anyone with the full link or QR code can view it without signing in for 15 minutes. Anyone who opens it can still save a copy.
